data.title: Parkopedia to offer real-time EV charging data in Southeast Asia
data.description: Parkopedia is partnering with charging data aggregator Voltality to provide real-time EV charging information to carmakers in four SEA markets. This will cover around 4,500 charging locations, 15,000 connectors, and 23 charge point operators across Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia.

data.title: India: Gujarat deploys 30 electric buses in Gandhinagar
data.description: Gujarat, a state in western India, has deployed 30 electric buses for public transport in its capital, Gandhinagar. The state procured these e-buses under the PM e-Bus Sewa Scheme, launched by the country's Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA) in 2023.

data.title: Audi A6 e-tron travels 1,338 km without recharging
data.description: European Rally Champion Miko Marczyk has set a Guinness World Record with an Audi A6 Sportback e-tron performance. On a single battery charge, he covered 1,338 kilometers with an average consumption of 7.09 kWh/100 km.

data.title: Tesla begins series deliveries of the Semi
data.description: Tesla has delivered the first series-production vehicles of its Semi electric truck to customers in Nevada, referring to it as the start of high-volume production. At the same time, the firm's order backlog is growing. However, Tesla has not yet provided specific details about the current production rate or pricing.

data.title: Pakistan: Islamabad police force acquires 50 electric cars
data.description: Pakistani capital Islamabad has acquired 50 new electric cars for its police force. The new electric police car fleet has already entered operations and is being used across the city.

data.title: Nova Bus receives follow-up order for 120 electric buses in Ottawa
data.description: Canadian transit operator OC Transpo has ordered another 120 electric buses of the LFSe+ type from Volvo subsidiary Nova Bus. A total of 175 electric buses have now reportedly been ordered in Ottawa to date.

data.title: VW postpones US return of the ID. Buzz to 2028
data.description: Volkswagen will reintroduce the ID. Buzz in the US in the first half of 2027 as a 2028 model year. It means the US will miss a second consecutive model year as a result of the delay.

data.title: Kia PV5 Chassis Long Range gets 71.2 kWh battery as sole UK option
data.description: Kia plans to sell PV5 Chassis exclusively with its 71.2 kWh Long Range battery in the UK. The South Korean firm says the additional capacity is intended for operators with longer or less predictable routes and fewer charging opportunities.

data.title: InstaVolt to retain CHAdeMO charging across network
data.description: While many carmakers and other charging networks are increasingly turning away from CHAdeMO connectors, InstaVolt is holding fast. The UK fast-charging network has reaffirmed its commitment to retaining CHAdeMO connectors as a permanent feature of its network.

data.title: Samsar upcycles EV battery from 1000th Nissan Leaf
data.description: EV battery remanufacturing startup Samsar Resources is celebrating a key milestone: it has now repurposed 1000 Nissan Leaf batteries into new energy storage.

data.title: Sorégies acquires BP Pulse fast-charging network in France
data.description: French energy provider Sorégies is taking over BP's fast-charging business in France. The package includes more than 600 existing charging points, nearly 200 more in development, as well as the associated technology and operations team.

data.title: Mercedes tests new Gen4 battery cells from ProLogium
data.description: Mercedes-Benz is expanding its collaboration with ProLogium and is gaining preferential access to its new Gen4 battery technology. The cells will now be comprehensively tested for their suitability for potential future vehicle applications.

data.title: PowerCo postpones battery cell production in Canada
data.description: Volkswagen subsidiary PowerCo has significantly delayed the timeline for its battery cell production in St. Thomas, Canada. Whereas construction was initially set to begin in 2027, the company now expects operations to begin in 2029.

data.title: €600 million for Renault’s Spanish production sites
data.description: French automaker Renault has announced plans to invest a total of €600 million by 2030 to modernize its Spanish plants in Valladolid and Palencia. Five new models, including two EVs, will be produced there. Additionally, a battery assembly line will be established in Valladolid.

data.title: Geely counters BYD with 2.25 MW charging system
data.description: Geely is entering the race for ever-higher charging powers in China with a new generation of its Smart Charging technology. Paired with a battery capable of up to 12C, electric cars should be able to charge from ten to 70 percent in just four and a half minutes using a proprietary charging system.

data.title: Renault 8 Gordini celebrates electric comeback – but only as a one-off
data.description: Renault has recently revived some of its most legendary models as one-off pieces. Now, the Renault 8 Gordini, introduced in 1964, is getting the same treatment: the classic sedan is being reimagined as a two-seater electric coupe with a design inspired by motorsport.

data.title: UK orders open for updated Renault 5 E-Tech
data.description: Renault has opened order books for the updated Renault 5 E-Tech in the UK. Prices remain unchanged despite a number of technical improvements to the electric supermini.

data.title: Green SM expands electric taxi and rental services in Indonesia
data.description: VinFast subsidiary, Green SM, has launched an initial fleet of 500 6-seater VinFast Green Limo electric cars for its ride-sharing, taxi and rental services in Indonesia. The Vietnamese automotive giant's ride-sharing subsidiary has also launched VinFast electric motorbikes as part of its service in the Southeast Asian country's capital and its largest city, Jakarta.

data.title: First drive in the Geely E2: an agile compact BEV with RWD and C-segment space
data.description: The new Geely E2 is shaking up the B-segment. With a starting price of €19,990, this compact BEV not only offers generous space comparable to the C-segment - it also impresses with agile driving characteristics thanks to its rear-wheel drive. Two efficient powertrains and comprehensive equipment packages complete a positive first impression.

data.title: Hyundai and LGES launch battery storage pilot using repurposed EV batteries
data.description: Hyundai and Kia are collaborating with LG Energy Solution on a large-scale demonstration project for charging stations with battery storage systems as an external buffer, using second-life batteries from EVs on the E-GMP platform.
